verdict.rationale: Gmail ships a documented public RESTful API for reading and managing mailboxes, threads, messages and labels, with send and draft endpoints, push notifications on mailbox changes, and granular OAuth scopes. Developers corroborate that it replaced hacky IMAP integrations with a few HTTP calls. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt at the probed developers.google.com paths, and community reports that Google's OAuth restrictions on third-party apps limit consumer access.
